items.title: 8.5 Conditions for equilibrium (equilibrium ki shartein) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.5, printed page 171.

blocks.text: Equilibrium ko tab parha jata hai jab yeh conditions (shartein) poori hon:

items: Equilibrium ki halat sirf reversible reactions par apply hoti hai.
Equilibrium sirf tab ban sakta hai jab reaction ka container band ho. Reactants ya products ka koi hissa bahar nikalne na diya jaye.

blocks.alt: Do vessels (bartan) jin mein CaCO3(s) ki red, CaO(s) ki green aur CO2(g) ki chhoti grey balls hain. (a) Band vessel: neeche CaCO3 aur CaO ka mixture aur oopar CO2 band (trapped). (b) Oopar se khula vessel: taqreeban sara solid CaO ban chuka aur CO2 munh se nikal rahi hai. Har vessel ke neeche CaCO3(s) ⇌ CaO(s) + CO2(g). Neeche symbols ki key.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.2: (a) Closed system (band system) mein equilibrium ban jata hai (b) Open system (khule system) mein equilibrium nahi ban sakta (kitab ki Figure 8.2 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono bartanon mein CaCO₃(s) ⇌ CaO(s) + CO₂(g) ho raha hai. (a) Band bartan mein CO₂ andar hi rehti hai, is liye woh CaO se mil kar dobara CaCO₃ bana sakti hai: reverse reaction bhi chalti hai aur equilibrium ban jata hai. (b) Khule bartan mein CO₂ bahar nikal jati hai, reverse reaction nahi ho pati aur aakhir mein taqreeban sara CaCO₃ CaO ban jata hai: equilibrium nahi banta.

items: Equilibrium ke liye reversible reaction aur band container zaroori hain.
CaCO₃ ⇌ CaO + CO₂ sirf tab equilibrium mein aata hai jab CO₂ bahar na nikal sake.
